content.title: These Stocks Moved the Most Today: Applied Materials, Walmart, Strategy, Warner Bros., and More
content.summary: The chip equipment maker reported better-than-expected earnings and revenue after Thursday’s close, and forecast solid results for the current quarter, which ends in January.  Walmart  was flat after the company announced longtime CEO Doug McMillon will retire next year.  John Furner, the current CEO of Walmart U.S., will succeed McMillon on Feb. 1, the company said.
